name: The Lazaret
description: Vesper Gate's old quarantine hulk, cut loose and left in a slow orbit off the Gate
character: The fever wards the Gate towed out of the way when the new hospice opened: a sealed intake, a corridor of narrow wards and a service duct along the keel. Nobody is meant to live there, so whoever does keeps the lights low and hears a ship clamp on through the hull long before anyone comes through the hatch.
